# Golf Swing Master
> Free browser-based AI golf swing analysis from an uploaded video, with no app installation required.

## About
Golf Swing Master is an ArcherLab web tool that reviews visible checkpoints in an uploaded golf swing video. It provides relative feedback on posture, tempo, impact phases, balance, and practice priorities.

## Analysis Tools
- Korean: https://golf.archerlab.dev/analysis
- English: https://golf.archerlab.dev/analysis-en
- Japanese: https://golf.archerlab.dev/analysis-jp

## Practice Guides
- Korean self-practice guide: https://golf.archerlab.dev/seo/golf-dokak
- English driver slice guide: https://golf.archerlab.dev/seo/fix-driver-slice
- Japanese self-practice guide: https://golf.archerlab.dev/seo/golf-dokugaku
- Japanese driver slice guide: https://golf.archerlab.dev/seo/driver-slice-naoshikata

## Service Facts
- Runs in a web browser and does not require an app installation.
- The uploaded video is used temporarily for analysis and deleted after processing.
- Shared analysis-result text is retained for 30 days.
- Results are relative estimates affected by filming conditions and do not certify skill or handicap.
- Privacy policy: https://golf.archerlab.dev/privacy-en
- Terms of use: https://golf.archerlab.dev/terms-en
